title: Write nx-archweave's agent rules into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md for the AI hosts you use

hosts.description: The AI coding tools you use. Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md; Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI read AGENTS.md. Defaults to toolkit.config.json's aiHosts, else Claude Code.

x-prompt.message: Which AI coding tools do you use? (space to select, enter to confirm; none selected = toolkit.config.json's aiHosts, else Claude Code)

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to toolkit.config.json's locale, else en

teamRules.description: Include the Team Rules section (collaboration rules for a shared repository). Defaults to toolkit.config.json's agentRules.teamRules, else false

dryRun.description: Print the full generated content and effective decision without writing
